name: Nike Inter Kids Training Dri-Fit Strike

description.subtitle: Nike Long Training Pant from Inter Milan 2025 2026 for boy - purple
description.intro: Designed for young footballers who dream big, Nike Inter Strike 2025/26 pants combine comfort, breathability and freedom of movement. Its technical fabric allows training without distractions, while the official design brings team identity from the base.
key_benefits: Durable comfort: Dri-FIT technology that eliminates sweat.
Optimum fit: Cut with zips on the ankles.
Quarry style: Inspired by the Inter's official equipment.
Practicidad total: Bolsillos funcionales con cremallera.
Highlighting design: Purple color adapted to young cracks.
